title: nan
authors: Ebrahimi A.; Mosavi M.R.; Ayatollahi A.
key_contribution: Presents a lightweight GPS/INS/VO multi-sensor positioning system that maintains accuracy during GPS outages (via pseudo-GPS neural network) and visual distortions, validated in simulation.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Filter_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
